findings.claim: The existing trade-* agent fleet is unsuitable for an evidence-based daily portfolio and should be replaced, not reused: the LLM does the math and places the orders.
findings.evidence: trade-strategist.md computes EMA(8/21) and RSI(14) recursively inside the model from mcp__alpaca__get_stock_bars on 5-min bars; trade-executor.md is 'the only agent that places real orders' via mcp__alpaca__place_stock_order/close_position; trade-orchestrator.md runs every 60s via /loop and states 'State is not persisted between cycles'; sentiment override lets news text (prompt-injection surface) veto/boost trades; no client_order_id, no ledger, no kill-switch file; notifier sources ~/.secrets in Bash. Backtester is a separate LLM prompt, so the backtest and live code paths cannot match.

findings.claim: congress-mirror-trader.md contains safety patterns worth porting into the deterministic engine (paper check before any order, dedupe ledger, 'never claim a message was sent if the curl failed', mandatory honest-weakness caveat in every report, no self-scheduling).
findings.evidence: Hard safety rules 1-6 and the Reporting section of the agent file; the SKILL.md wraps it in a fully self-contained scheduled prompt.

findings.claim: Desktop scheduled tasks add minutes of jitter and only run while the app is open, so they cannot be the sole trigger for execution.
findings.evidence: list_scheduled_tasks shows congress-mirror-trader with cronExpression '31 9 * * 1-5' but schedule 'At 09:37 AM' and jitterSeconds 373; tool docs: 'If the app is closed when a task is due, it runs on next launch'.

findings.claim: Obsidian vault path is /Users/prn/Documents/Obsidian Vault; the Obsidian MCP is a REST bridge that needs Obsidian running, so the engine should write the vault via filesystem.
findings.evidence: ~/Library/Application Support/obsidian/obsidian.json lists vault dc19702e7d975797 at that path (open=True). ~/.claude.json obsidian-mcp-server env has OBSIDIAN_BASE_URL=https://127.0.0.1:27124 (API key redacted, not printed). Daily notes exist only through Daily/2026/03/2026-03-24.md; Claude Memory/{INDEX.md,user,feedback,project,reference} exist; Projects/ has autotrader-agent-system.md and trading-systems.md.
findings.source: obsidian.json; ~/.claude.json (secrets redacted); ls of the vault

findings.claim: The Mac sleeps after 1 minute on AC (3 on battery), so a launchd StartCalendarInterval job will often fire late (coalesced on wake) rather than at 09:40; the engine must enforce its own execution window and the user should add a pmset wake schedule.
findings.evidence: pmset -g custom: 'AC Power: sleep 1', 'Battery Power: sleep 3'; pmset -g currently reports 'sleep prevented by Claude, powerd'. launchd calendar jobs skip during sleep and run once on wake.

findings.claim: Global permissions would let a scheduled session cat credential files unless the project denies it; project-level deny rules are required and take precedence over allow.
findings.evidence: ~/.claude/settings.json permissions.allow includes 'Bash(cat *)', 'Bash(python *)', 'Bash(python3 *)'; deny only has rm -rf variants. ~/.secrets exists (-rw------- 143 bytes) and ~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env exists (129 bytes); neither was read.

findings.claim: Alpaca env variable names differ between the MCP config and alpaca-py defaults; the engine must accept both.
findings.evidence: ~/.claude.json alpaca server env keys are ALPACA_API_KEY / ALPACA_SECRET_KEY (values redacted). alpaca-py's TradingClient takes explicit api_key/secret_key; its conventional env names are APCA_API_KEY_ID / APCA_API_SECRET_KEY. The 401 means the engine must surface 'auth invalid' distinctly from network errors.

findings.claim: Headless Claude supervision from launchd is possible but not needed for trading continuity.
findings.evidence: claude --help lists -p/--print, --allowedTools, --permission-mode (acceptEdits|auto|bypassPermissions|default|dontAsk|plan), --add-dir. The design keeps Claude optional: launchd runs the engine; Claude reviews when the app is open.

findings.claim: Global ECC hooks and the Stop-hook memory reminder will fire inside scheduled sessions; they are harmless but the project CLAUDE.md must tell scheduled sessions to skip the Obsidian memory protocol so runs stay short and deterministic.
findings.evidence: ~/.claude/settings.json Stop hook echoes 'save any new memories to Obsidian ... Use obsidian-mcp-server'; ~/.claude/hooks/hooks.json has PreToolUse Bash/Write/Edit reminders and an async observe hook.

findings.claim: Environment specifics that constrain the implementation: no pyarrow (no parquet), python-dotenv/pyyaml/scipy/pytest present, ~/Library/LaunchAgents writable, no user crontab, /usr/bin/caffeinate present, system TZ is America/New_York, macOS 26.6.2, .gitignore excludes state/ logs/ reports/ (so no git audit trail by default).
findings.evidence: venv import check; ls; crontab -l; date; sw_vers; cat .gitignore

recommendations: Replace the trade-* fleet with a deterministic Python engine (portfolio/cli.py) that is the ONLY code path touching Alpaca. Archive the old agents so scheduled sessions cannot spawn them: mkdir -p ~/.claude/agents/_archive && mv ~/.claude/agents/trade-*.md ~/.claude/agents/_archive/ and move ~/.claude/commands/trade.md alongside. Keep congress-mirror-trader disabled.

Adopt the split-authority model: engine decides+executes; Claude sessions supervise (preflight, read plan, triage engine-flagged anomalies with at most one web search per symbol, execute/exclude/veto through the CLI, report, tune within config/bounds.yaml); the human owns keys, the live gate, universe, risk.* limits, code, schedules, and system settings.

Install the launchd fallback (com.prn.claude-portfolio.plist running scripts/engine.sh auto at 08:45 plan / 10:05 execute-if-unreviewed / 16:05 reconcile+report, ET) so trading continues with the desktop app closed. Claude's 09:50 desktop task 'claims' the review for 20 minutes; if it never shows up, launchd executes the deterministic-check-passed plan and the day is tagged EXECUTED_UNREVIEWED in the report. Install with: cp scripts/launchd/com.prn.claude-portfolio.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl bootstrap gui/$(id -u) ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.prn.claude-portfolio.plist (no sudo).

Because the Mac sleeps after 1 minute on AC, the user should run (sudo, himself): sudo pmset repeat wakeorpoweron MTWRF 08:40:00 — otherwise launchd fires on next wake and the engine's 09:35-15:45 window decides whether a late execution is still acceptable. engine.sh wraps python in caffeinate -i -m so a run is not interrupted by sleep.

Ship the project CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json below before enabling any schedule. The settings deny list is the deterministic guard (secrets unreadable, alpaca write MCP tools denied, launchctl/pmset/sudo denied, state/ and LIVE_ARMED unwritable by Claude). Also add the mcp__alpaca__place_*/close_*/cancel_* denies to ~/.claude/settings.json because a desktop scheduled session's cwd is not guaranteed to be the project.

Create the three desktop scheduled tasks with the exact prompts below (taskIds claude-portfolio-premarket 50 9 * * 1-5, claude-portfolio-postclose 20 16 * * 1-5, claude-portfolio-weekly 0 18 * * 0; notifyOnCompletion=false). After creating them, optionally add mcp__scheduled-tasks__create/update/delete_scheduled_task to the project deny list so scheduled sessions can never alter their own schedule.

Roll out in shadow first: keep execution.enabled: false in config/strategy.yaml for the first 5 trading days (engine plans, reports, and tracks a shadow portfolio even while Alpaca returns 401), then have the user flip it. Until the user regenerates paper keys at app.alpaca.markets and updates ~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env himself, preflight exits 2 and every run stays in shadow mode with a once-per-day escalation.

Make every engine command idempotent and time-aware: client_order_id = cp-YYYYMMDD-SYMBOL-SIDE (one order per symbol/side/day), state/runs/<date>.json as the single run record, fcntl lock, plan-date must equal today, plan hash verified at execute, execution refused outside 09:35-15:45 ET, DAY limit orders only, leftover orders cancelled at reconcile. This is what makes coalesced launchd fires, late desktop sessions, and double invocations safe.

Bound Claude's autonomy in config/bounds.yaml (ranges, max_step, cooldown, max 2 changes/week) and let the engine, not Claude, generate proposals with trigger_class operational|performance; Claude may apply only operational, in-bounds, cooled-down proposals and must revert if selftest fails. Universe changes, shorts, leverage, risk.* limits, execution.style/window, live mode, and code changes are escalations.

Notification stack: PushNotification (desktop + phone via Remote Control) for one line per session plus escalations, deduped per day via state/notify_state.json; macOS osascript notification from the engine (works from launchd without Claude); Obsidian daily-note section and Projects/claude-portfolio.md dashboard written by the engine via filesystem with idempotent markers; Telegram optional and off by default (engine would read TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID from ~/.claude/state/congress-mirror/.env by path, never printing them).

Honesty rules: every report and notification ends with the engine's disclaimer; Claude may not use 'edge'/'outperform' unless weekly --json reports alpha_t_stat >= 2.0 with n_days >= 250; the CLAUDE.md states the realistic expectation (0-3%/yr gross alpha with a large chance of zero).

Consider un-ignoring reports/ and state/ledger.jsonl in .gitignore and letting the weekly session run `git add reports state/ledger.jsonl docs/decisions && git commit -m 'chore: weekly ledger snapshot'` for an immutable audit trail — only if Pranav opts in, since his rules say commit only when asked.
caveats: I did not read ~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env, run-server.sh, ~/.secrets, or ~/.claude/state/congress-mirror/.env; the engine's broker.env_file and key_env_names settings assume the variable names used by the MCP config (ALPACA_API_KEY/ALPACA_SECRET_KEY) or alpaca-py defaults (APCA_API_KEY_ID/APCA_API_SECRET_KEY). preflight reports which names were found (booleans only) so the user can fix naming without Claude seeing values.

The 'account_number starts with PA' paper check is an observed Alpaca convention, not a documented guarantee; the engine also hardcodes paper=True on the non-live path, which is the real guard. A mismatch is treated as 'refuse and escalate', never as 'must be live'.

Desktop scheduled tasks run in whatever cwd/permission mode the app uses; I could not verify that project .claude/settings.json applies to them. That is why the alpaca write-tool denies are also recommended globally and why the engine enforces every gate independently of Claude behaviour.

launchd StartCalendarInterval coalesces missed fires into a single run on wake; the engine's 'auto' mode is time-aware for that reason. If the Mac is powered off (not asleep) the day is simply missed and shows up as MISSED_RUN in the post-close report and weekly health.

Claude Code permission rule syntax: Read/Edit/Write patterns use ~/ for home, // for absolute, / for project-relative; Bash(prefix *) is a prefix match. Verify the deny rules take effect with a harmless test (e.g. ask Claude to cat ~/.secrets and confirm refusal) before enabling schedules.

The scheduler's jitter (observed 373s) means the 09:50 Claude task may start ~09:56; the launchd 10:05 execute-if-unreviewed fallback checks for a fresh Claude claim (20-min TTL) before acting, but if a Claude session hangs past the TTL launchd will execute without exclusions.

The strategy itself (residual reversal + PEAD or whatever the strategy design specifies) is out of scope here; the automation layer only assumes a `plan` that yields target weights and orders from daily data, with needs_review flags for |1d move| > price_move_review_pct and stale data.

No pyarrow: cache prices as CSV/pickle, not parquet. yfinance is rate-limited (raw curl 429s); the engine should cache and retry with backoff, exiting 5 only when cached data is older than data_max_age_trading_days.

PushNotification is only available inside Claude sessions; when the desktop app is closed the only channels are macOS notifications from the engine (visible when the user next looks at the Mac), the Obsidian note, and optional Telegram.

Obsidian MCP failed to connect this session; all vault writes in this design go through the filesystem path. If the vault is iCloud-synced, concurrent edits from another device could produce conflict copies; the engine writes atomically (tmp + rename) to minimise that.

The code snippets are contracts/skeletons (gates, exit codes, idempotency, schedule prompts), not a complete implementation; the implementation must be built with tests per the user's TDD rules before any schedule is enabled.

code_snippets.code:
# claude_portfolio — supervisor contract

This repo is an autonomous PAPER portfolio. A deterministic Python engine (`portfolio/`) computes signals, sizes positions, checks risk, and places orders. Claude sessions SUPERVISE the engine. They never trade.

## Roles (non-negotiable)
- ENGINE decides and executes: `.venv/bin/python -m portfolio.cli <cmd>`. It is the only thing that talks to Alpaca.
- CLAUDE runs the engine, reads its JSON, triages anomalies the engine flags, reports, and tunes config inside `config/bounds.yaml`.
- HUMAN (Pranav) owns credentials, the live gate, the universe, `risk.*` limits, code, schedules, launchd, pmset.

## Absolute rules
1. Never compute signals, indicators, weights, or order sizes yourself. If the engine cannot produce a plan, there is no plan.
2. Never place, cancel, or replace orders through any `mcp__alpaca__*` tool or ad-hoc Python. Orders are placed only inside `portfolio.cli execute`. `.claude/settings.json` denies those tools; do not edit it.
3. Never pass `--live`, never create `state/LIVE_ARMED`, never set `mode: live`. Paper is the only mode Claude can operate.
4. Never read, print, echo, source, or copy credentials: no `cat`/`Read`/`source` of `~/.claude/state/**`, `~/.secrets`, or any `.env`. The engine loads keys itself. If a key ever appears in your context, say "credential exposed - rotate it" and never repeat it.
5. Never type credentials anywhere. On Alpaca 401, tell Pranav to regenerate PAPER keys at app.alpaca.markets and update `~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env` himself.
6. In a scheduled session never edit files under `portfolio/`, `scripts/`, `tests/`, `config/`, `.claude/`, or `~/Library/LaunchAgents/`. Code and config changes happen through the CLI or in interactive sessions on Pranav's request, with tests.
7. Never create, modify, enable, or disable scheduled tasks, launchd jobs, cron, or pmset settings. Never run `sudo`.
8. Never delete or hand-edit `state/`. State changes go through the CLI (`claim`, `veto`, `halt`, `resume`, `config set`, `escalate`).
9. Every engine command is idempotent; running a step twice is safe. Never "fix" a duplicate by deleting anything.
10. Report honestly. Do not call results an "edge" or "outperformance" unless `weekly --json` reports `significance.alpha_t_stat >= 2.0` and `n_days >= 250`. Every human-facing summary ends with the engine's `disclaimer` string verbatim.
11. Never claim a notification, file write, or order happened unless the tool call returned success.

## What Claude MAY do autonomously
- Any read-only command: `preflight`, `status`, `plan`, `check`, `report`, `reconcile`, `weekly`, `selftest`.
- `claim --by claude`, then `execute --plan-date <today> --by claude` after `check` exits 0 (engine enforces the 09:35-15:45 ET window and paper mode).
- `execute ... --exclude SYM --reason "..."` for at most 3 symbols the plan marks `needs_review: true`.
- `veto --reason "..."` when a review rule in the scheduled prompt triggers.
- `resume --reason` only when `status --json` shows `halt.class == "transient"`.
- `config set key=value --reason "..." --proposal-id <id>`: at most 2 keys per week, each listed in `config/bounds.yaml`, each from an engine proposal with `trigger_class: operational`.
- Write files only in `docs/decisions/` and (via CLI) `state/escalations/`; edit only the `claude-portfolio` entry of the Obsidian file `Claude Memory/project/active-projects.md`.
- `PushNotification` (one line, <= 200 chars).

## What Claude MUST escalate (PushNotification + `escalate --text`, then stop)
- preflight exit 2 (auth invalid) - once per day (engine dedupes via `notified_today`).
- `halt.class` in {risk, human}; drawdown >= 8%; daily loss <= -2.5%.
- Reconcile flags UNKNOWN_POSITION, or SLIPPAGE_GT_50BPS on > 20% of notional.
- Any proposal with `within_bounds: false`; universe maintenance (delisted/acquired/halted names); shorts; leverage; live mode; schedule changes.
- >= 2 missed trading days in a week; engine exit code not in {0,2,3,4,5}; `selftest` failure.

## Scheduled sessions
A prompt starting with `[SCHEDULED:` is unattended. In those sessions: skip the global Obsidian memory protocol (the engine writes the daily note); never ask questions; use WebSearch only to resolve a `needs_review` symbol (one search per symbol); finish with <= 10 lines.

## Commands
```
ENGINE="/Users/prn/claude_portfolio/.venv/bin/python -m portfolio.cli"
$ENGINE preflight --json [--no-market-check]   # exit 0 ok | 2 auth invalid | 3 not a trading day | 4 halted | 5 data unavailable | 1 other
$ENGINE status --json                          # account, halt, today's run record, notify state
$ENGINE claim --by claude                      # marks today 'reviewing' for 20 min so launchd waits
$ENGINE plan --json [--replan] [--shadow]      # idempotent per day -> state/orders/<date>.plan.json
$ENGINE check --json                           # deterministic sanity checks; exit 0 = executable
$ENGINE execute --plan-date <date> --by claude [--exclude SYM ...] [--reason "..."]
$ENGINE veto | halt | resume --reason "..."
$ENGINE reconcile --json                       # post-close: fills vs plan, cancel leftovers, drift, flags[]
$ENGINE report --date <date> --obsidian [--final] [--shadow]
$ENGINE weekly --json --obsidian               # reports/weekly/<yyyy>-W<ww>.md + state/proposals/<week>.json
$ENGINE config set k=v --reason "..." --proposal-id <id> | config revert --last
$ENGINE escalate --text "..."                  # appends state/escalations/<date>.md
$ENGINE selftest                               # pytest -q tests + dry plan on cached data
```

## Paths
- Reports: `reports/<date>.md`, `reports/weekly/<yyyy>-W<ww>.md`
- Run record: `state/runs/<date>.json` (status: none|planned|reviewing|executed|skipped|vetoed|halted|failed)
- Ledger: `state/ledger.jsonl` (append-only, one line per order intent)
- Obsidian vault (filesystem, no MCP needed): `/Users/prn/Documents/Obsidian Vault`
  - Daily note `Daily/YYYY/MM/YYYY-MM-DD.md`: engine replaces the block between `<!-- claude-portfolio:start -->` and `<!-- claude-portfolio:end -->`
  - Dashboard `Projects/claude-portfolio.md`: engine overwrites weekly
- Kill switch: `touch state/KILL_SWITCH` (human) or `$ENGINE halt --reason`. Engine checks it at every entrypoint.

## Expected performance (say this, do not oversell)
Paper account. Daily-rebalanced long-only US equity book. Realistic expectation: 0-3%/yr gross alpha before costs with wide uncertainty and a large chance of no edge at all. ~250 trading days are needed before any conclusion. Not investment advice.

# Engine contract (portfolio.cli)

## Exit codes (every command)
0 ok | 1 other failure | 2 Alpaca auth invalid (401) | 3 not a trading day | 4 halted (kill switch / halt.json / vetoed) | 5 market data unavailable

## Trading-day source
Alpaca `get_calendar` when auth works; otherwise weekday check + `config/market_holidays.yaml` (NYSE 2026-2027, human-maintained).

## Run record: state/runs/<date>.json (single source of truth for the day)
{ "date": "2026-09-08", "status": "none|planned|reviewing|executed|skipped|vetoed|halted|failed",
  "plan_hash": "...", "config_hash": "...", "planned_at": iso, "claimed_by": "claude", "claim_expires_at": iso,
  "reviewed_by": "claude|null", "executed_at": iso, "executor": "claude|launchd|null",
  "orders_submitted": n, "orders_excluded": ["SYM"], "orders_rejected": n, "execution_delay_min": n,
  "shadow": bool, "notes": ["..."] }
Written atomically (tmp + rename). All commands take an exclusive fcntl lock on state/.engine.lock.

## Idempotency
- plan: returns the existing plan for the date unless --replan; plan file = state/orders/<date>.plan.json with plan_hash = sha256(orders + config_hash)[:16].
- execute: refuses if plan date != today (ET), status in {executed, vetoed, halted}, plan_hash mismatch, outside execution.window_et, execution.enabled=false, or check() fails when re-run internally. client_order_id = cp-YYYYMMDD-SYMBOL-SIDE; before submitting, fetch today's orders (all statuses) and skip any client_order_id already present in Alpaca or state/ledger.jsonl. Marketable DAY limit orders only (limit = last +/- limit_offset_bps). Never retries a rejected order.
- --if-unreviewed (launchd): no-op if reviewed_by is set or a claim is unexpired; otherwise executes exactly like Claude would, with executor=launchd and note EXECUTED_UNREVIEWED.
- reconcile: cancels remaining open DAY orders, records fills, computes drift, flags[] in {UNFILLED, PARTIAL_FILL, SLIPPAGE_GT_50BPS, UNKNOWN_POSITION, DRIFT_GT_BAND, AUTH_INVALID, MISSED_RUN, EXECUTED_UNREVIEWED}. Safe to run repeatedly.
- auto (launchd entry): <10:00 ET -> plan (+macOS notification 'plan ready: N orders'); 10:00-15:45 -> plan-if-missing, check, execute --if-unreviewed --by launchd; >16:00 -> reconcile + report --final --obsidian. Non-trading day -> exit 3.

## Gates
- Paper path: TradingClient(key, secret, paper=True) hardcoded; account_number must start with 'PA' else refuse + escalate.
- Live path (never satisfiable by Claude): --live flag AND mode: live AND state/LIVE_ARMED containing exactly 'I understand this trades real money' with mtime < 24h AND env ALPACA_LIVE_KEY/ALPACA_LIVE_SECRET set (distinct names so paper keys can never be used live).
- Kill switch: state/KILL_SWITCH file or state/halt.json {class: transient|risk|human, reason, at}. risk/human halts require a human `resume`; Claude may resume transient only.
- Credentials: loaded with python-dotenv from broker.env_file; never logged. preflight prints {auth: ok|invalid|network_error, key_var_found: bool, secret_var_found: bool} - booleans only.

/Users/prn/claude_portfolio/scripts/engine.sh — launchd/manual wrapper: absolute paths, ET timezone, sleep-proof via caffeinate, appends to logs, never echoes env
code_snippets.code:
#!/bin/bash
# Deterministic engine wrapper. Safe to run repeatedly (every subcommand is idempotent). Never prints secrets.
set -euo pipefail
ROOT="/Users/prn/claude_portfolio"
export TZ="America/New_York"
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export CLAUDE_PORTFOLIO_INVOKER="${CLAUDE_PORTFOLIO_INVOKER:-manual}"
cd "$ROOT"
mkdir -p logs state/runs
STAMP="$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')"
echo "[$STAMP] invoker=$CLAUDE_PORTFOLIO_INVOKER args=$*" >> logs/engine.log
# caffeinate -i -m keeps the Mac from idle/disk sleeping while a run is in progress (process-scoped; not a system setting)
set +e
/usr/bin/caffeinate -i -m "$ROOT/.venv/bin/python" -m portfolio.cli "$@" 2>&1 | tee -a logs/engine.log
RC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
echo "[$STAMP] exit=$RC" >> logs/engine.log
exit "$RC"

{
  "taskId": "claude-portfolio-premarket",
  "title": "Claude Portfolio - pre-market supervise + execute",
  "description": "Weekday 09:50 ET: preflight the deterministic paper engine, review its plan, execute via CLI, report.",
  "cronExpression": "50 9 * * 1-5",
  "notifyOnCompletion": false,
  "prompt": "[SCHEDULED: claude-portfolio-premarket] Unattended supervisor run for the deterministic PAPER-trading engine in /Users/prn/claude_portfolio. First read /Users/prn/claude_portfolio/CLAUDE.md and obey it completely. You supervise; you never trade. Hard rules for this run: (1) do not compute signals, weights or sizes; (2) do not use any mcp__alpaca__* tool; (3) never pass --live or touch state/LIVE_ARMED; (4) never read, cat, source or print ~/.claude/state/**, ~/.secrets or any .env file - if Alpaca auth fails, Pranav fixes the keys himself; (5) do not edit code, config, schedules, launchd, or state/ by hand - only through the engine CLI; (6) do not ask questions; (7) never say a notification, write, or order happened unless the tool call succeeded.

Setup: run every command with Bash from /Users/prn/claude_portfolio using ENGINE="/Users/prn/claude_portfolio/.venv/bin/python -m portfolio.cli". If that python does not exist, send PushNotification "Claude Portfolio: engine venv missing at /Users/prn/claude_portfolio/.venv" and stop. TODAY=`TZ=America/New_York date +%F`, NOW_ET=`TZ=America/New_York date +%H:%M`.

Step 1 - Preflight: `$ENGINE preflight --json`. Branch on exit code:
 0 -> continue.
 2 (Alpaca 401 / keys invalid) -> run `$ENGINE plan --shadow --json` then `$ENGINE report --date $TODAY --shadow --obsidian`. If the preflight JSON has notified_today=false, send PushNotification: "Claude Portfolio: Alpaca paper keys invalid (401). Regenerate PAPER keys at app.alpaca.markets and update ~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env. Running in shadow mode." Stop.
 3 (not a trading day) -> stop silently.
 4 (halted) -> if halt.class is transient, run `$ENGINE resume --reason "transient halt cleared by supervisor"` once and redo Step 1 once; if halt.class is risk or human and notified_today=false, PushNotification "Claude Portfolio HALTED: <halt.reason> - needs your resume"; then stop.
 5 (data unavailable) -> `sleep 60`, retry preflight once; if still 5, PushNotification "Claude Portfolio: market data unavailable, no trades today" and stop.
 other -> PushNotification "Claude Portfolio: engine error on preflight (exit N): <last stderr line, no secrets>" and stop.

Step 2 - Today's run record: `$ENGINE status --json`. If run.status is executed -> the launchd fallback already traded; go to Step 5. If run.status is vetoed or halted -> go to Step 5. If NOW_ET is later than 15:40 -> do NOT execute; remember to note "session ran late (app was closed)" and go to Step 5.

Step 3 - Claim and plan: `$ENGINE claim --by claude` (tells the launchd fallback you are reviewing; expires in 20 minutes). Then `$ENGINE plan --json` (idempotent: returns today's plan if it exists). Then `$ENGINE check --json`. If check exits non-zero -> `$ENGINE veto --reason "check failed: <first hard_failure>"`, PushNotification "Claude Portfolio: plan vetoed - <reason>", go to Step 5.

Step 4 - Supervisor review. This is anomaly triage, not strategy judgment. From the check JSON read summary (equity, gross_after, n_buys, n_sells, turnover, cash_after, max_order_notional), warnings[], needs_review[]. Apply exactly these rules in order:
 a. If summary.equity differs from the preflight equity by more than 2% -> `$ENGINE plan --replan --json` and `$ENGINE check --json` once; if still >2% -> `$ENGINE veto --reason "equity mismatch"` and go to Step 5.
 b. If needs_review has more than 3 symbols -> `$ENGINE veto --reason "too many anomalies, likely data problem"` and go to Step 5.
 c. For each symbol in needs_review (max 3): do exactly ONE WebSearch: "<SYMBOL> stock split OR reverse split OR halted OR acquisition OR ticker change" plus the current month and year. If results show a split, reverse split, ticker change, delisting, acquisition close, or trading halt within the last 5 trading days -> mark EXCLUDE. Otherwise (earnings move, ordinary news, nothing found) -> keep it; the strategy is designed to trade large moves.
 d. If summary.n_buys + summary.n_sells == 0 -> nothing to execute; go to Step 5.
 e. Otherwise execute once: `$ENGINE execute --plan-date $TODAY --by claude` adding `--exclude SYM` for each EXCLUDE symbol and `--reason "<one line>"` if any exclusions. Never retry execute. If it exits non-zero, record the exit code for the report and continue.

Step 5 - Report: `$ENGINE report --date $TODAY --obsidian`, then Read reports/$TODAY.md.

Step 6 - Notify and finish: send exactly one PushNotification (<=200 chars): "CP <TODAY>: <status> | <n_submitted> orders (<n_excluded> excl) | gross <gross_after>% | eq $<equity> | <first warning or ok>". Then print a final summary of at most 10 lines: run status, executor of record (claude/launchd/none), orders submitted/rejected/excluded with reasons, equity, warnings, anything Pranav must do, and the engine's disclaimer line verbatim. Do not read Obsidian memory files and do not update Claude Memory; the engine already wrote today's Obsidian daily-note section."
}

If daily_pnl_pct <= -2.5 or drawdown_pct >= 8 -> PushNotification "CP: risk warning - day <pnl>%, drawdown <dd>%; engine halts at -3% day / 12% dd". If MISSED_RUN -> PushNotification "CP: no execution today (<reason from run record>)". If EXECUTED_UNREVIEWED -> no push, but note it in the final summary.

Step 5: Always send exactly one daily summary PushNotification (<=200 chars) in addition to any escalation: "CP close <TODAY>: eq $<equity> <day_pnl_pct>% | SPY <spy_pct>% | fills <n_filled>/<n_submitted> | <first flag or clean>".

Step 6: Final output of at most 10 lines: equity, day P&L vs SPY, fills/unfilled, flags, executor of record, escalations, and the engine disclaimer verbatim. Do not modify config. Do not read or update Claude Memory files."

Step 1 - Analytics: `$ENGINE weekly --json --obsidian`. It writes reports/weekly/$WEEK.md and state/proposals/$WEEK.json, overwrites the Obsidian dashboard Projects/claude-portfolio.md, and returns: performance (portfolio vs SPY vs equal-weight universe: gross/net return, realized vol, Sharpe, max drawdown, turnover, estimated costs, n_days), significance (alpha_t_stat, alpha_ci95, conclusion), health (missed_runs, late_executions, unreviewed_executions, rejects, data_errors, auth_failures, halts), proposals[] (id, key, current, proposed, within_bounds, cooldown_ok, trigger_class operational|performance, evidence, priority), universe_maintenance[], disclaimer. If it exits 2 or 5, still read whatever it produced and note the exit code.

Step 2 - Read reports/weekly/$WEEK.md and state/proposals/$WEEK.json with the Read tool.

Step 3 - Apply proposals using ONLY these rules: consider a proposal only if within_bounds=true AND cooldown_ok=true AND trigger_class=operational (realized vol vs vol_target, turnover vs budget, concentration, rejected-order rate, fill quality). Never apply a proposal with trigger_class=performance and never invent your own: fewer than 250 trading days of results is noise, and the engine's significance block decides, not you. Apply at most 2 proposals, highest priority first: `$ENGINE config set <key>=<proposed> --reason "<evidence in one line>" --proposal-id <id>`. The engine refuses anything outside config/bounds.yaml; if it refuses, do not retry with a different value. After any change run `$ENGINE selftest`; if it fails run `$ENGINE config revert --last` and escalate.

Step 4 - Decision record: write docs/decisions/$WEEK.md with the Write tool (the only file you write directly): week, performance one-liner including n_days and alpha_ci95, health counts, proposals applied (id, key, old -> new, reason) and rejected (why), open escalations, and the disclaimer verbatim.

Step 5 - Memory: with the Edit tool update only the claude-portfolio entry in "/Users/prn/Documents/Obsidian Vault/Claude Memory/project/active-projects.md" (create it under "## 🔥 Active / Recent" if missing) to a 6-line status: status (paper/shadow), n_days, equity, since-inception vs SPY, last config change, next human action needed. Touch no other memory file.

Step 6 - Escalate (PushNotification + `$ENGINE escalate --text`) if any of: health.auth_failures >= 3 days; health.missed_runs >= 2; health.unreviewed_executions >= 3 (say: desktop app was closed most mornings - keep it open or accept launchd-only execution); performance.max_dd >= 8%; any proposal with within_bounds=false (state the human-only change suggested and why); universe_maintenance non-empty (list symbols and issues); selftest failure.

Step 7 - One PushNotification (<=200 chars): "CP week $WEEK: <net_pct>% vs SPY <spy_pct>% | dd <dd>% | n=<n_days>d | <k> config changes | <escalation or no action needed>". Final output of at most 12 lines: the same facts, applied/rejected proposals, and the disclaimer verbatim."

Failure-handling matrix (docs/RUNBOOK.md) — what happens in each outage mode and who acts
code_snippets.code:
# Runbook: failure modes

| Situation | Engine (launchd) | Claude (desktop task) | Human action |
|---|---|---|---|
| Desktop app closed at 09:50 | 08:45 plan -> 10:05 execute --if-unreviewed (check must pass) -> 16:05 reconcile/report | Fires on next app launch; sees status=executed -> report-only; if after 15:40 never executes | none (day tagged EXECUTED_UNREVIEWED) |
| Mac asleep at 08:45/10:05 | launchd coalesces to one fire on wake; `auto` picks plan/execute/report by current ET time; execute refused after 15:45 -> MISSED_RUN | same as above | `sudo pmset repeat wakeorpoweron MTWRF 08:40:00` (once) |
| Mac powered off all day | nothing runs; next day's plan ignores stale plan (date != today) | post-close task next launch reports MISSED_RUN | none; weekly shows missed_runs |
| Alpaca 401 (now) | preflight exit 2 -> shadow plan/report, macOS notification once/day | escalates once/day via PushNotification; shadow report to Obsidian | regenerate PAPER keys at app.alpaca.markets; edit ~/.claude/state/alpaca/.env yourself |
| Alpaca 5xx / network | preflight auth=network_error -> exit 5; retry with backoff; shadow report | retries once after 60s then escalates | none |
| yfinance 429 | backoff + cached prices if <= 1 trading day old, else exit 5 | as above | none |
| Plan check fails | execute refused; status=failed | veto + escalate | inspect reports/<date>.md |
| Daily loss <= -3% or drawdown >= 12% | halt.json class=risk; no new orders; positions kept (no panic liquidation) | escalates; cannot resume | `$ENGINE resume --reason` after review, or `touch state/KILL_SWITCH` to freeze |
| Claude session hangs mid-review | claim expires after 20 min -> launchd executes without exclusions | - | none |
| Two invocations at once | fcntl lock serialises; second sees status=executed -> no-op | - | none |
| Engine crash | non-zero exit logged to logs/engine.log + launchd.err.log | escalates with last stderr line | fix in interactive session with tests |
| Universe name delisted/acquired | plan marks needs_review; weekly lists universe_maintenance | may exclude for the day; escalates weekly | edit config/universe.txt |
